label: Человек
description: A 10-sentence usage card for человек with role, number, and case movement.

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Basic countable noun. 1. 'Человек' is one of the most important Russian person nouns. 2. 'Один' keeps the line simple. 3. This is the cleanest count-and-name starter.
Strategic focus: Demonstrative reference. 1. 'Этот' points at a specific person. 2. 'Человек' stays central and unambiguous. 3. The phrase is useful in conversation and description.
Strategic focus: Person plus location. 1. 'В комнате' gives a clear physical scene. 2. 'Человек' remains the noun focus. 3. This is a simple but high-frequency structure.
Strategic focus: Accusative object use. 1. 'Человека' shows the object form. 2. 'Ждут' is plural and unspecified. 3. This sentence teaches role shift without changing the core noun.
Strategic focus: Possession frame. 1. 'У человека есть' is a standard Russian pattern. 2. 'Имя' makes the sentence personal and useful. 3. This is a very natural identity sentence.
Strategic focus: Dative recipient. 1. 'Человеку' is the person receiving help. 2. 'Помог' is a high-value social verb. 3. The sentence is small but grammatically rich.

Strategic focus: Instrumental relation. 1. 'С человеком' is a common prepositional/instrumental frame. 2. 'Разговаривают' gives the sentence social meaning. 3. It is a great pattern for interaction language.
Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 1. 'О человеке' is the standard 'about a person' shape. 2. 'Говорят' keeps the sentence general. 3. This is useful for reading and discussion contexts.
Strategic focus: Singular versus plural. 1. The sentence contrasts one person with many people. 2. It is short and highly memorable. 3. This is a good anchor for semantic number training.
Strategic focus: Basic evaluation. 1. 'Хороший' is a common adjective that learners use immediately. 2. 'Человек' is the core social noun. 3. The phrase is useful in daily praise and description.
